channel.title: Press Release For Business — Technology
channel.description: Announcements categorized as technology. All items are paid announcements published on behalf of the named organization and are not independently verified.

item.title: Action Global News Relaunches as an Original-Reporting News Site With a Named Editor and Published Standards
item.description: Action Global News removed third-party feeds and embeds and now publishes only its own sourced reporting, edited by publisher Zach Wennstedt.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Releases a Free Ten-Minute Self-Check That Shows Whether AI Assistants Name a Local Business
item.description: The free self-check runs six checks across Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity, scores a business out of 24 and asks for no email.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Launches Custom Business Dashboards Built Around Each Company's Own KPIs
item.description: Eye To Ad Media has launched custom business dashboards built around each company's own KPIs, with a live sample-data demo and three build tiers.

item.title: Advertising For Contractors Warns Trades Businesses to Prepare Now as Google Folds Local Services Ads Into Google Ads
item.description: Advertising For Contractors is advising trades businesses to prepare for Google's migration of Local Services Ads into Google Ads via pay-per-lead Performance Max campaigns, which began for US advertisers in August 2026 and removes the standalone LSA dashboard and manual cost-per-lead controls.

item.title: What Dietitian-Led GLP-1 Support Looks Like
item.description: GLP-1 medications are one part of a weight-management plan. Here is what registered-dietitian involvement in a GLP-1 program usually includes, and questions worth asking before enrolling.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Expands Generative Engine Optimization Practice as AI Assistants Reshape How Customers Find Local Businesses
item.description: Eye To Ad Media has expanded its generative engine optimization practice, formalizing a service line focused on entity consistency, structured data and machine-readable publishing for businesses that need to appear in AI-generated answers.

item.title: World VR Mall Opens Browser-Based Virtual Shopping Concourse With Merchant Storefronts Linking to Live Ecommerce Sites
item.description: World VR Mall has launched a browser-based three-dimensional shopping concourse where visitors walk a central walkway and enter merchant storefronts that link through to those merchants' own ecommerce sites. No headset or download is required.

item.title: VR Flying Simulator Launches Browser-Based Procedural Trainer Aimed at Student Pilots Between Lessons
item.description: VR Flying Simulator has launched a browser-based procedural trainer for student pilots covering checklist discipline, instrument scan and navigation tracking. The company states explicitly that it is not an approved training device and logs no hours toward any certificate.

item.title: Bear Creek Auto Glass Advises Drivers That Windshield Replacement Is Not Finished Until Cameras Are Recalibrated
item.description: Bear Creek Auto Glass is advising Colorado drivers that vehicles with windshield-mounted forward-facing cameras require ADAS recalibration after glass replacement, and that miscalibration commonly produces no dashboard warning.

item.title: Advertising For Contractors Releases a Free Chatbot Builder for Trades Websites
item.description: Advertising For Contractors has released a free contractor chatbot generator that produces an installable website assistant, aimed at capturing inquiries that arrive outside business hours.

item.title: Eye To Ad Media Introduces AI Search Visibility Assessments for Small Businesses
item.description: Eye To Ad Media has introduced AI search visibility assessments that test how a business is represented when customers ask AI assistants about its category, and identify which competitors are named instead.

item.title: Denver Web Design Publishes Guidance on Small Business Site Speed
item.description: Denver Web Design has published guidance on diagnosing and improving small business website speed, covering the common causes of slow loading.

item.title: World VR Mall Opens Merchant Storefront Applications
item.description: World VR Mall has opened storefront applications to retailers, offering placement on its browser-based three-dimensional concourse with checkout remaining on the merchant's own ecommerce site.

item.title: VR Flying Simulator Expands Its Checklist Practice Library
item.description: VR Flying Simulator has expanded the checklist sequences available in its browser-based procedural trainer for student pilots. The software remains explicitly not an approved training device.
